title: Open TodayWeather from a shared link
scenario: Open a shared app link in a mobile browser when TodayWeather does not launch automatically. The images show the local fallback page captured at a mobile viewport using Chromium with Android and iPhone user agents.

steps.title: Use the web or open the Android app
steps.instruction: Tap the primary web button to open TodayWeather in your browser. On Android, you can also tap the app button. A browser that supports Android intents can hand off to an installed app or offer Google Play.
steps.caption: Korean fallback page with the web and Android app buttons.
steps.expected: The web button opens the web app. The store buttons offer installation.

steps.title: Continue in Safari or Chrome
steps.instruction: If a messaging app keeps the link in its browser, use the browser menu to open it in Safari or Chrome. In Safari, use the Smart App Banner when it appears. You can also open the web app, App Store or Google Play from this page.
steps.caption: English fallback page with the web and store links.
steps.expected: The web and store options remain available even when the browser does not launch the app.
